w:r.w:t: This Software Requirements Specification (SRS) document describes the functional and non-functional requirements for
is a next-generation decentralized rental marketplace designed to bridge the trust gap between tenants and landlords in high-density urban markets across India.
This document is intended to serve as the definitive reference for the
system's design, development, and testing activities. It captures all requirements gathered during the analysis phase and establishes a baseline for project scope.
This document adheres to the following typographic conventions:
Bold text is used for key terms, headings, and emphasis.
Italics are used for technical terms, file names, and URLs.
Section numbering follows a hierarchical pattern: X, X.X, X.X.X.
All requirements are stated in the positive and use 'shall' for mandatory requirements and 'should' for optional/desirable requirements.
This SRS is intended for the following stakeholders:
Developers & Engineers: Sections 2–4 provide implementation-level detail on features, APIs, and data structures.
Project Manager: Section 1 (scope) and Section 5 (non-functional requirements) are most relevant.
Testers / QA: Sections 3 and 4 specify system features and interface requirements for test case development.
Faculty / Evaluators: The full document provides a comprehensive overview of the system.
End Users (Tenants & Landlords): Section 2 (Overall Description) provides a non-technical summary of the product.
Readers seeking an architectural overview should begin with Section 2.1 (Product Perspective) before proceeding to detailed feature descriptions in Section 3.
is a web-based, full-stack rental marketplace platform with the following high-level objectives:
Provide a verified, trusted property listing and discovery platform for urban India.
Implement a proprietary Trust Score system derived from Aadhaar-based identity verification and community reviews.
Enable end-to-end rental workflows — from property discovery and visit booking to tenancy management and reviews.
Offer role-based dashboards for Tenants, Landlords, and Administrators.
Support bilingual operation in English and Hindi.
The platform is NOT intended to handle financial transactions (rent payments) or provide legal services in version 1.0.0.
IEEE Std 830-1998: Recommended Practice for Software Requirements Specifications
is a new, self-contained rental platform that positions itself in the gap between traditional property listing portals (e.g., 99acres,
) and trust-verification services. While existing platforms focus primarily on property discovery,
core innovation is 'Reputation Portability' and 'Verification as a Service'.

Frontend Web Application: A React + Vite single-page application providing the user interface.

and the backend on Render.com. The database and storage are managed by
OTP-Based Authentication: Phone number based sign-in using a 6-digit OTP, powered by Fast2SMS. No password required.
Aadhaar Identity Verification: Privacy-preserving Aadhaar hashing (SHA-256 with salt). The raw Aadhaar number is never stored, ensuring regulatory compliance.
Trust Score Engine: A proprietary weighted scoring algorithm (0.0–5.0) that factors in identity verification and dual-weighted reviews (visit reviews vs. living reviews).
Property Listings Management: Landlords can create, edit, archive, and restore property listings with up to multiple photos stored in
Geospatial Property Search: Bounding-box search with Leaflet map integration, radius filters, rent range filters, and BHK filters.
Visit Booking System: Tenants can request property visits; landlords can accept or decline. Full slot management with date and time selection.
Tenancy Lifecycle Management: Three-stage lifecycle: Visit → Occupation → Checkout, preventing fake reviews.
Review System: Post-visit and post-tenancy review submission with star ratings. Feeds directly into the Trust Score.
In-App Messaging: Full conversation system with 5-second polling for near-real-time communication between tenants and landlords.
Notification System: In-app notification bell with 30-second polling for new activity alerts.
Admin Panel: Secure passphrase-protected admin dashboard for platform-wide user and listing management.
Saved Properties: Tenants can save and retrieve favourite listings.
Bilingual Support: Full English and Hindi language support via i18next.
Shadow Records: Prevents reputation fraud by preserving Aadhaar hashes of deleted accounts.

[HIGH] The system shall allow a user to initiate authentication by entering a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.
[HIGH] The system shall generate a 6-digit OTP and deliver it via SMS using Fast2SMS or log it to console in simulation mode.
[HIGH] The system shall verify the OTP within a configurable expiry window (default: 10 minutes).
[HIGH] Upon successful OTP verification, the system shall issue a signed JWT token encoding the user's ID, role, and expiry.
[HIGH] New users shall be redirected to a profile setup screen to enter their name, email, and select their role.

proprietary reputation metric for users. It is a weighted composite of identity verification status and review history.
[HIGH] The Trust Score shall be a numeric value between 0.0 and 5.0, stored with two decimal precision.
[HIGH] Aadhaar verification shall contribute a +2.0 base score bonus.
[HIGH] Visit reviews (type='visit') shall carry a weight of 1.0 in the score calculation.
[HIGH] Tenancy reviews (type='living') shall carry a weight of 1.5, reflecting greater reliability of long-term experience.
[HIGH] The Trust Score formula shall be: Score = (Sum of Visit Ratings * 1.0 + Sum of Living Ratings * 1.5) / (Count of Visits * 1.0 + Count of Living * 1.5).
[MEDIUM] The Trust Score shall be recalculated and updated in the users table on each new review submission.

frontend is a single-page React application with the following primary screens and interface requirements:
Landing Page (/): Hero section with city search bar, featured listings, and marketing sections. Must render above-the-fold content within 2 seconds on a standard connection.
Property Search (/search): Split-pane view with a Leaflet map on one side and property cards on the other. Filter panel for rent, BHK, and furnishing. Responsive — stacks vertically on mobile.
Property Detail (/property/:id): Full-page listing view with photo gallery/carousel, amenities list, landlord info with Trust Score, reviews section, Visit Booking modal, and Save/Share buttons.
Authentication Flows (/auth/tenant, /auth/landlord): Two-step OTP entry flow. Phone input → OTP verification → Profile setup (for new users).
Tenant Dashboard (/tenant/dashboard): Stats summary row, upcoming visit card, quick actions, profile completion banner.
Landlord Dashboard (/landlord/dashboard): Pending visit requests, active property grid with Edit/Hide/Delete actions, platform stats.
Add Property (/landlord/properties/add): Three-step wizard: Basic Info → Amenities & Photos → Location with draggable Leaflet pin.
Messages (/dashboard/messages): Two-panel chat UI with conversation sidebar and message thread.
Admin Dashboard (/admin/dashboard): Stats overview, user management table, listing management table.
All pages must meet WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines. The interface must support bilingual display in English and Hindi, switchable from the header navigation.
is a cloud-hosted web application and does not interface directly with any hardware components. The following hardware assumptions apply:
Client Device: Any device with a modern web browser and internet connectivity. No minimum hardware specification is enforced beyond browser compatibility.
GPS/Location: The Add Property page uses the browser's Geolocation API (
) to pre-fill coordinates. This is optional; users may manually enter or pin location.
Camera/File Upload: Property photo upload uses the standard HTML file input. Supports JPEG, PNG, and
Client-to-Backend: All communication between the React frontend and Flask backend shall use HTTPS REST API calls with JSON request/response bodies.
SDK over HTTPS. Service role key is used for admin-level operations, bypassing RLS.
Backend-to-SMS: Communication with Fast2SMS uses HTTPS GET requests with the API key in the header.
Real-time Simulation: The application uses client-side polling (5s for messages, 30s for notifications) rather than WebSocket connections. True WebSocket support is deferred to future versions.
Security: All API communications in production must use TLS 1.2 or higher. JWT tokens must be included in the Authorization: Bearer {token} header for all authenticated endpoints.
The landing page shall achieve a Largest
Paint (LCP) of under 2.5 seconds on a standard broadband connection.

The bounding-box search algorithm must operate at O(log N) using indexed
shall be debounced with a minimum 400ms delay to prevent excessive API calls.
The messaging poll interval shall be 5 seconds. The notification poll interval shall be 30 seconds. Polling must not block UI rendering.
Photo uploads shall support files up to 10MB per photo. The backend shall reject files exceeding this limit with a 413 error.
The system shall implement input validation on all API endpoints to prevent SQL injection and XSS attacks.
The system shall never log or display raw Aadhaar numbers at any layer of the stack.
The system shall validate all date/time inputs for booking slots; invalid formats (e.g., non-TIME strings) shall be rejected with a 400 error before reaching the database.
The booking time field shall only accept valid HH:MM:SS format values. String values like 'Anytime' shall be mapped to a default time (e.g., 10:00:00) before persistence.
Authentication: All protected routes must require a valid JWT. Tokens must expire within 24 hours.
Role-Based Access Control: Tenant endpoints shall be inaccessible to Landlord tokens and vice versa. Admin endpoints require an admin-role token.
Aadhaar Privacy: Raw Aadhaar numbers must be hashed client-side or immediately upon receipt by the backend, before any logging or database write.
table must be protected by RLS rules preventing deletion by non-admin roles.
Password/Passphrase: The admin passphrase must be stored as an environment variable and never hardcoded in source code.
CORS: The backend shall only allow CORS requests from explicitly whitelisted origins in production.
Photo URLs: Property photos stored in
must be served from a public bucket. Signed URLs are not required for V1.0.
Reliability: The backend shall return HTTP 200 on the /health endpoint at all times. Graceful error handling (try/except) must be implemented on all routes that interact with external services (
, Fast2SMS, Redis) to prevent cascading failures.

Maintainability: The backend must use a Blueprint-based modular structure. Each business domain must be isolated in its own file. The frontend must separate pages (pages/), reusable components (components/), and state management (store/).
Portability: The backend must be deployable via a
on any Python 3.11+ PaaS. The frontend must be deployable as a static site to any CDN supporting SPAs with client-side routing.
Usability: The interface must be operable by a non-technical user (e.g., a landlord unfamiliar with technology). Core flows (search, view, book) must be completable in under 5 user interactions.

Testability: All API endpoints must be independently testable using standard HTTP tools (curl, Postman). The backend must include at least one diagnostic script (diagnose_api.py) to verify end-to-end connectivity.
Scalability: The database schema must support partitioning of the messages and notifications tables by regional code in future versions. The search system must be extensible to
Internationalization: The frontend must support English and Hindi languages via i18next. Language detection must use the browser's locale setting as the default. Language files must be stored in /
Accessibility: The UI shall follow WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines. All interactive elements must be keyboard-navigable. Images must include alt text.
Legal Compliance: Property listings must comply with the platform's Terms of Service (/terms). The platform must display a Privacy Policy (/privacy) and Trust & Safety page (/trust-safety).
